description:
The GenV WG40 CompGate40 7psi Black represents Turbosmart's GenV thermal engineering, featuring modular actuator housing and maximum flow efficiency.

• Brand & Engineering: Genuine Turbosmart high-performance motorsport hardware.
• Construction: Precision CNC-machined billet aluminum housing with hard-anodized finish.
• Valve Size: 40mm high-temp stainless steel valve assembly.
• Cooling & Rotation: Integrated liquid cooling ports and 360-degree actuator cap positioning.
